notes.title: Final Update - working on small sequel
notes.content:
This will (hopefully) be the final update for the game. I am currently making a smaller sequel with "Crash" style levels that will come out late 2024 or 2025.

Gameplay
- Removed crash levels as they were experimental and glitchy. I am developing a sequel game based around them so they will be fixed in that game.

Collision/Map
- Fixed collision on truck in construction site.
- Fixed collision on windows and back wall in lab.
- Due to the lab collision bug it was impossible to get the Lab Beet, now it is possible again.
- Fixed OOB issue on sewer.


UI
- Fixed text wrapping issue on level creator area select buttons.
- Fixed level select cursor memory issue
- Fixed level creator cursor centered

Also I wanted to thank the volunteer playtesters who helped me find some of these bugs and gave me feedback on the game:

notes.title: Visual Updates in Preparation for the Switch Port
notes.content: Over the past month or so I've been pushing minor updates to improve some levels and update the visuals. There is now a new character controller, a simple cutscene system at the beginning of each area, and full controller support. All of this is in preparation for the Switch port which should launch in early October. Over the next few weeks I'll be pushing some more updates to improve the visuals of some of the areas and improve the controller support for the level creator. If you have any suggestions or find any bugs please let me know in the steam discussions as I'd like to improve the game as much as possible before the Switch launch.

notes.title: PictoPull Released
notes.content:
PictoPull is finally releasing after 1.5 years of development. On sale for 20% during launch week. This is my first published video game and it came down to the wire a bit, so please report any bugs and make suggestions in the community forum. Over this next week I will be updating the game daily to improve to the workshop ui functionality and fix any bugs that pop up.  Here is the current timeline for updates I am planning

1-2 Weeks -Maintenance/Quality of life
- Workshop UI and level management improvements
- Bug fixing

1 month - Finishing up partially implemented stuff that didn't make it to release
- Full Controller support
- Level Tweaks
- Adding a new feature that lets levels have multiple goals
- NEW LEVEL TYPE: Crash levels
- Localizations
- Adding hints to every level

3-6 Months
- NEW LEVEL TYPE: Stretch levels
- More built in level packs based created by me or community contributors.
- ???? TBD
